svg.aria-label: Hover card dimensional drawing: variable popup height, scrolling insets, skeleton geometry, stable placement, shadow and exploded layers

g.text: SCALE 1.35:1 · DEFAULT WIDTH · CONTENT HEIGHT SCHEMATIC
PORTAL → POSITIONER → POPUP → SCROLL AREA → BODY

svg.text: DEFAULT WIDTH W0; CALLERS MAY OVERRIDE W.
HEIGHT FOLLOWS CONTENT AND CLAMPS TO MH.
SCROLL AREA BLEEDS S2 INTO PANEL PADDING.
VIEWPORT RESTORES S2; BODY INSET STAYS B + S1.
BOTTOM / CENTER IS THE DEFAULT ANCHOR.
INITIAL COLLISION SIDE LOCKS UNTIL CLOSE.
LOADING REPLACES CONTENT WITH A SKELETON.
TRIGGER / TOUCH SIZE / BODY LAYOUT ARE CALLER-OWNED.
BL + SP ± Y IS A NOMINAL CONSTRUCTION; NO HARD BLUR EDGE.
SOURCE: HOVER-CARD + POSITION + VARIANTS · SCROLL AREA · SKELETON · GLOBALS.CSS
LIVE OPEN / FONT-READY CHECK · DEFAULT W0 / S1 / S2 / B / R1 CONFIRMED; HEIGHT IS CONTENT-DEPENDENT.
